name: nimbus-core-v36
description: Nimbus Core V36 Phase 13 autonomous source intelligence with fully dynamic UI and validation

scripts.validate: npm run clean && npm run check:config && npm test && npm run check:cloudflare && npm run check:runtime && npm run build:web
scripts.validate:source: npm run clean && npm run check:config && npm test
scripts.predeploy:worker: npm run validate && npm run check:release
scripts.db:apply:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply nimbus-core-v36-db --local --config wrangler.worker.jsonc
scripts.db:apply:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply nimbus-core-v36-db --remote --config wrangler.worker.jsonc
scripts.verify: npm run validate:source && npm run build:web
